feed.title: VitaCoreX LLC — Documents, Translations & Personal Services
feed.subtitle: Translations, online notarization, apostille assistance, tax returns, company formation, business plans and document support for private clients. Small claims documents for companies. Tampa, FL.

entry.title: All Private-Client Services in One Place
entry.summary: Choose a task, see the starting price or request a quote: translations, online notarization, apostille assistance, tax returns, company formation, business plans, contracts and documents, immigration forms and N-400 document support.

entry.title: Prices — Starting Service Fees
entry.summary: Starting prices in USD. Online notarization $25 per notarial act; certified translation $25 per 250 source words; individual tax return from $149 — final price after review; company formation $99 + state filing fee. Government, filing and court fees are separate.

entry.title: Online Notarization — $25 per Notarial Act
entry.summary: Remote online notarization by a Florida Notary Public by video, from anywhere you have a camera and a valid photo ID. Additional acts, witnesses and printed copies are extra.

entry.title: Certified and General Translations
entry.summary: Certified translation $25 per 250 source words (one standard page) with a signed translator certificate. General translation $0.10 per source word, $25 minimum order. Word count, price and date are confirmed before payment.

entry.title: Apostille Assistance — from $119 Service Fee
entry.summary: We find the right authority for your document and destination country, prepare the submission and track it. Service fee from $119 for the first document; government fees and shipping are itemized separately.

entry.title: Individual Tax Returns — from $149
entry.summary: Federal individual return (Form 1040) prepared by our accounting team after a short scoping call — from $149, final price after review. Self-employed return from $249; state return add-on from $49.

entry.title: Request a Quote or Ask About Your Situation
entry.summary: Describe your task and we reply with the matching service and price. Sending a request is free of charge; it is not a free legal consultation.

entry.title: Company Formation — $99 + State Filing Fee
entry.summary: We prepare and submit the formation filing for the state and entity type you have chosen. $99 + state filing fee, or $199 + state filing fee with EIN application assistance. No subscription.

entry.title: Business Plans — from $499
entry.summary: A defined basic plan built from your questionnaire: business model, market summary with sources and an assumption-based financial outline, with an editable file and one revision.

entry.title: Contracts & Document Support — from $99
entry.summary: Preparing and organizing agreements, letters and forms you have chosen, with a clear deliverable agreed before work starts. Legal advice or representation only through an independent licensed attorney, with your consent.

entry.title: Immigration Forms & Documents — Clerical Preparation
entry.summary: Typing a USCIS form you or your adviser have chosen, a completeness check and an organized document packet — from $149. N-400 document support from $249. Form selection, eligibility advice and representation are not provided; USCIS fees are separate.

entry.title: Small Claims for Companies — Case Packet from $199
entry.summary: For companies: an organized case file for one claim against one defendant from $199, a month of case support from $399, or a retainer with court representation under a power of attorney where the court allows it from $749 per case. Court hours $65 per hour, 2-hour minimum paid upfront. Court fees are separate; your state and court are confirmed before you pay.
